# Matthew C. Nowlin

> Matthew C. Nowlin is an Associate Professor of Political Science at the University of Texas at Arlington. He studies public policy, especially environmental and energy policy and politics: theories of the policy process, policy learning, cultural theory and belief systems, deliberation, climate change, energy and nuclear waste, and natural hazards.
